name: Yungay, Atacama Desert
geology.surface_material: hyperarid gravelly soil with salt crusts
summary: Driest non-polar desert; perchlorate soils near the dry limit of life.

name: University Valley, McMurdo Dry Valleys
geology.surface_material: frozen sandy regolith over ice-cemented permafrost
water_resources.subsurface_water_notes: dry permafrost over ice-cemented ground at ~0.3 m
summary: Coldest, driest Antarctic valleys; ice-cemented ground like Mars mid-latitudes.

name: Badwater Basin, Death Valley
summary: Hot evaporite playa; salt sequences resemble Martian chloride/sulfate basins.

name: Holuhraun lava field
summary: Very young flood basalt; analog for Amazonian lavas of Elysium Planitia.

name: Mauna Kea upper slopes
water_resources.subsurface_water_notes: localized permafrost lens in cinder cone
summary: Palagonitic tephra is spectrally close to Martian bright dust (JSC Mars-1 source).

name: Haughton Impact Crater
summary: Well-preserved polar impact crater; ops testbed (HMP).

name: Rio Tinto headwaters
summary: Acidic iron-sulfur system; mineralogically close to Meridiani Planum.

name: Dresser Formation, Pilbara Craton
summary: Some of Earth's oldest biosignatures; benchmark for Jezero sample science.

name: Lonar Crater
geology.surface_material: basaltic impact ejecta and lake sediment
geology.geological_features: simple impact crater (~1.8 km)|alkaline saline lake|ejecta blanket
summary: Rare impact into basalt - same target rock as most Martian craters.

name: Dallol hydrothermal field, Danakil
summary: Polyextreme (hot, acidic, hypersaline) - probes the limits of habitability.

name: Dalangtan Playa, Qaidam Basin
summary: Cold, high, salty and windy; less-studied match for Gale's sulfate unit.

name: Kharga Depression yardang field
geographic.geological_formation: Quaternary playa sediments over Nubian sandstone
summary: Unidirectional-wind yardangs; under-used analog for Medusae Fossae.

name: Kamil Crater
geographic.region: East Uweinat / Gilf Kebir region, Egypt
geology.surface_material: sandstone with impact ejecta and meteorite fragments
geology.geological_features: small fresh impact crater (~45 m)|ray ejecta
summary: Pristine small crater with rays; analog for fresh small craters on Mars.

name: La Corona lava tube (Cueva de los Verdes)
subsurface.notes: stable cave climate; ESA PANGAEA training site
summary: Long accessible lava tube; analog for Martian/lunar skylight caves.

name: Bockfjord Volcanic Complex
summary: Carbonate globules like those in Martian meteorite ALH84001.

name: Central Amazon rainforest (control)
summary: NEGATIVE CONTROL: should score low against every Mars site.

name: Jezero Crater
geology.surface_material: basaltic regolith over igneous floor and delta sediments
water_resources.subsurface_water_notes: ancient lake; no present liquid water
summary: Ancient lake delta with carbonates; Perseverance sample-caching site.

name: Gale Crater (Aeolis Mons)
geology.geological_features: impact crater (~154 km)|central layered mound|dune field
summary: Habitable ancient lake confirmed by Curiosity; sulfate-to-clay transition.

name: Olympus Mons summit caldera
geology.surface_material: basaltic lava flows mantled by dust
summary: Tallest volcano; extremely thin air above most dust.

name: Melas Chasma, Valles Marineris
geographic.geological_formation: Hesperian canyon with interior layered deposits
summary: Deep canyon with sulfate layers; hard landing and mobility terrain.

name: Southern Utopia Planitia (Zhurong site)
summary: Flat, safe plains with probable buried ice.

name: Meridiani Planum
geology.surface_material: sulfate sandstone with hematite spherule lag
summary: Acid-sulfate sandstones and hematite; Opportunity's playground.

name: Hellas Planitia floor
geology.surface_material: basin fill with dust and possible ice-rich deposits
geology.geological_features: impact basin floor|honeycomb terrain|lobate debris aprons (rim)
summary: Lowest point on Mars; highest pressure and frequent dust storms.

name: Columbia Hills / Home Plate, Gusev Crater
geology.surface_material: altered basalt, volcaniclastics and silica outcrops
summary: Hot-spring silica and carbonates; a biosignature target.

name: Mawrth Vallis
summary: Thickest clay sequence on Mars; formerly a candidate landing site.

name: North Polar Layered Deposits (Planum Boreum)
summary: Massive water-ice reservoir with climate layering.

name: Arsia Mons cave skylights
geology.surface_material: basaltic lava flows with collapse pits
subsurface.notes: skylight candidates; length unknown; cave temperature unknown
summary: Candidate cave skylights; possible radiation-shielded habitats.

name: Medusae Fossae Formation
summary: Largest wind-eroded deposit on Mars; prime yardang comparison.

name: Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ice
summary: Shallow ice on flat plains; leading candidate for human landings.

name: Elysium Planitia (InSight site)
geology.surface_material: young lava plains with thin regolith
geology.geological_features: flood lava plains|hollow craters|Athabasca Valles nearby
summary: Very flat young lava plains; among the safest landing terrain.
